name: tomassedovic/tcod-rs
description: Rust bindings for libtcod 1.6.3, the Doryen roguelike library. Now archived and unmaintained; maintainers recommend bracket-lib or doryen-rs as successors. Historically significant as the first Rust roguelike bindings.
score_rationale: 229-star archived Rust bindings for libtcod, superseded by bracket-lib; kept for historical significance only.
summary: Archived Rust bindings for libtcod; superseded by bracket-lib
